properties.description:
Built 2026-10-13 on branch site/more-than-a-record:
- The opening line and "It is" call the record connected: each piece is linked to what it rests on and what it affects, so it can say what a change will reach. A new "It isn't" item, "Just a place to write things down", says a list of decisions can't do that.
- "What the record keeps" becomes "...and what the links let it answer". It lists five questions a list of notes can't answer, each backed by a served tool: a change's reach, needs nothing delivers and checks never run, decisions resting on a failed result, gaps nobody asked about, and who decided and what they did not choose.
- A new section, "It adds up", draws reflow2's own design week by week: records, the links between them, and decisions. Taleb's tinkering is the reading, and the page says reflow2 is not a large project.
The numbers come from counts.json, which tools/site_counts.py writes from the design committed at each release tag when pages.yml publishes the site (fetch-depth 0, and on every v* tag). Release manifests (INCLUDES) are counted apart. Without the file, the figure is hidden and the text says where the numbers come from.
Rendered at 1280 and 390 px wide: no script errors and no sideways overflow of the page. In_progress until merged and published. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: The home page says what the links between records let reflow2 answer, and charts reflow2's own design adding up one small decision at a time, counted from each release when the site is published
